title: Cybernetica to lead Estonia's transition to quantum-safe e-governance
summary: Announcement that Cybernetica was awarded strategic Estonian government procurements to lead the post-quantum/quantum-safe cryptography transition of national e-governance systems. Flagged for review as the issuer is a vendor-in-programme rather than a government body.

title: Küberturvalisuse strateegia 2024-2030 „Läbivalt IT-vaatlikum Eesti“
summary: Estonia's national cybersecurity strategy for 2024 to 2030 from the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications. It names quantum computers as a threat to current cryptographic algorithms, calls for quantum-resistant cryptographic solutions, and sets an objective that state information be protected with approved or certified quantum-safe communications security solutions, backed by a national crypto competence centre.

title: Krüptoalgoritmid ning nende tugi teekides ja infosüsteemides
summary: Technical study written by Cybernetica for RIA (version 2.0, 15 June 2023) on cryptographic algorithms and their support in libraries and information systems. Sections 2.7-2.8 cover the mathematical foundations of post-quantum cryptography, the state of its standardisation, the adoption of post-quantum algorithms and the challenges involved. It notes that Estonia had not yet published a timeline or guidance for migrating to post-quantum algorithms, warns of the risk to e-identity and digital signatures, and recommends hybrid modes.

title: TLS 1.3 võtme kvantkindel hübriidkehtestus (X25519MLKEM768)
summary: RIA technical article dated 29 April 2025 explaining hybrid quantum-safe key establishment in TLS 1.3, which combines classical X25519 with post-quantum ML-KEM. It walks through the protocol using diagrams and packet analysis.

title: Cryptographic algorithms lifecycle report 2016
summary: Research report procured by RIA and written with Cybernetica (version 3.0, 22 June 2016) on the lifecycle of cryptographic algorithms used in Estonia. It has a dedicated chapter on post-quantum cryptography covering quantum computers and the major candidate asymmetric primitives for the post-quantum era.

title: Krüptograafiliste algoritmide elutsükli uuring 2017
summary: RIA-commissioned technical study on the lifecycle of cryptographic algorithms (version 2.0, dated 9 February 2018). It states that preparations for the transition to post-quantum algorithms must begin now and discusses quantum-resistant algorithms in the context of the next ID card generation.

title: RIA CyberMeetUp in Tartu June 10th 2026
summary: RIA event page for its CyberMeetUp in Tartu on 10 June 2026, announcing that the edition would introduce Estonia's roadmap for the transition to post-quantum cryptography. The programme lists a Cybernetica researcher presenting the "Estonian PQC Migration Roadmap"; the page itself gives no roadmap content.

title: Kvantarvutikindlus, tehisintellekt ja tervishoid saavad küberis suure rahasüsti
summary: RIA news item (2025) relaying new ECCC funding calls under Digital Europe and Horizon Europe, including a call on moving to post-quantum public key infrastructures and Horizon calls on evaluating PQC primitives, securing PQC implementations and integrating PQC into protocols (deadlines 12.11.2025). The calls are EU calls; RIA, which hosts Estonia's national coordination centre (NCC-EE), passes them on.
